lines.text: The king rejoices in the LORD's strength, and the LORD has not withheld the request of his lips.
The LORD welcomes the king with rich blessings and places a turban of fine linen on his head.
The king asked for life, and the LORD gave him length of days; he trusts in the LORD.
The LORD's hand will seize His enemies and place them in a fiery furnace, and the fire will consume them.
The enemies' schemes will not prevail, since the LORD will put them to shame, and the people will sing.
